description: This file defines the Minify_HTML class responsible for minifying HTML content by removing whitespace, comments, and optimizing embedded style and script blocks. It includes methods for processing HTML strings, handling placeholders, and minifying CSS and JavaScript within HTML.

classes.name: Minify_HTML
classes.description: A class providing static methods to minify HTML content, including handling embedded CSS and JavaScript, comments, and whitespace optimization.

methods.name: minify
methods.description: Main method to minify an HTML string with optional processing callbacks for CSS and JS, and XHTML handling.

methods.name: _commentCB
methods.description: Callback to process HTML comments, preserving conditional comments.

methods.name: _reservePlace
methods.description: Stores content in placeholders and returns a unique placeholder string.

methods.name: _outsideTagCB
methods.description: Callback to trim whitespace outside of HTML tags.

methods.name: _removePreCB
methods.description: Callback to replace <pre> blocks with placeholders.

methods.name: _removeTaCB
methods.description: Callback to replace <textarea> blocks with placeholders.

methods.name: _removeStyleCB
methods.description: Callback to process and minify <style> blocks, handling CDATA and comments.

methods.name: _removeScriptCB
methods.description: Callback to process and minify <script> blocks, handling comments and CDATA.

methods.name: _removeCdata
methods.description: Removes CDATA markers from CSS or JS content.

methods.name: _needsCdata
methods.description: Determines if content requires CDATA wrapping based on XHTML rules.

search-terms: CSS and JS minification in HTML
